headline: 'Gas supply keeps decreasing'. Energy Ministry warns greenhouse farms in Uzbekistan
summary: Uzbekistan's Energy Ministry said falling gas extraction and limited resources mean it cannot guarantee uninterrupted gas supply to greenhouse farms. Businesses were advised to switch to alternative heating systems.
why: Uzbekistan is a Central Asian gas producer and consumer, so domestic output shortfalls affect energy prices, agricultural costs and the balance between supply and imports.
original_headline: “Gaz borgan sari kamayib boradi”. Energetika vazirligi O‘zbekistondagi issiqxona xo‘jaliklarini ogohlantirdi
